label: Fixed 30-Day Month for Monthly Payroll
description: When enabled, monthly Salary Slips use the configured fixed monthly divisor (default 30).

label: Monthly Salary Divisor (Days)
description: Fixed payroll-day denominator for monthly Salary Slips. Default 30; set 26 for a 26-day payroll convention. Allowed 1 to 31.

label: Monthly Salary Proration Mode
description: Deduction: fixed divisor minus unpaid days. Attendance: actual payable days when unpaid leave exists. Automatic: switches at the configured threshold.

label: Proration Crossover (Unpaid Days)
description: When unpaid-day equivalents reach this threshold, Automatic switches to Attendance mode.
